import 'dart:math';

List<int> sortArray(List<int> arr) {
  int n = arr.length;
  for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    bool swapped = false;
    for (int j = 0; j < n - i - 1; j++) {
      if (arr[j] > arr[j + 1]) {
        int temp = arr[j];
        arr[j] = arr[j + 1];
        arr[j + 1] = temp;
        swapped = true;
      }
    }
    if (!swapped) break;
  }
  return arr;
}
